I have been farming these 3 mu for 50 years, wheat in winter and maize in summer, and I learn by watching what works. Last year my wheat made about 450 jin per mu and maize about 500 jin. This year I will do mostly the same — change is risky, and a bad harvest is worse than wasting a little fertilizer.

For wheat, I plow with the rotary tiller after the maize comes off in October. I spread one 50-kg bag of compound fertilizer per mu as base — the 15-15-15 kind from the dealer in town, that is 100 jin per mu total. Then when the wheat turns green in March, I topdress with 40 jin of urea per mu. The dealer told me that is plenty of nitrogen, but I would rather put a bit too much than see my wheat go yellow like it did the year I tried to save money. I irrigate three times: once before winter to protect the seedlings, once at jointing, and once when the grain is filling. I spray herbicide once in early spring and fungicide once before heading. My neighbor Lao Zhang uses Jimai 22, an improved wheat seed, and his yield is always steady, so I buy the same.

For maize, after I cut the wheat in early June there is no time to plow deep. I use the no-till seeder right behind the combine. I put down 60 jin of compound fertilizer per mu with the seed, and when the maize is knee-high I spread another 40 jin of urea per mu. Maize does not need as much as wheat in my experience, and every bag of fertilizer is real money out of my pocket. I irrigate twice if the rain does not come — once at the big trumpet stage and once when the tassels are out. I spray herbicide right after sowing, and I watch for corn borer; if I see damage like two years ago, I spray once more. I buy Zhengdan 958 hybrid seed — 2 kg per mu — because everyone around here plants it and it does not fail.

I pump from my well, so water is there, but electricity costs me, so I count every irrigation. I do not hire labor — just me and my wife. My total fertilizer bill will be about 600 yuan for both crops, which is a big expense on 3 mu, but skipping fertilizer is gambling with my dinner.
